sections.advice: This Food stop near Chandon → Photo stop in Roche-la-Molière stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
Photo stop in Roche-la-Molière → Brignais can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Use High point near La Côte-Saint-André → Scenic stretch in Saint-Jean-de-Bournay as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
A line-crossing or merge area where relaxed sightseeing traffic can behave unpredictably.
Watch shade, leaves, gravel wash and damp patches; conditions decide the pace.
Viewpoints and car parks can create sudden stops in otherwise flowing terrain.
